_rates_note: sample_rate stays 122.88e6: it is the RX rate AND the device tick, and every slot/frame count below is in those ticks. The TX stream runs at tx_sample_rate; every TX waveform is generated at 122.88 and x2 interpolated at the radio boundary (include/dsp/band_filters.h). DAC 5898.24 / interpolation 24, ADC 4915.2 / decimation 40.
_frequency_note: Common NCO is the sub-6 2425 MHz; only the X-band channels override it (TX ch1 = B, RX ch2 = C). Zone, ADC calibration mode, inverse sinc and the +-25 MHz RX channel filter are DERIVED per channel from the NCO and the converter rates (PG269 rules), not configured: sub-6 -> zone 1, cal mode 1, filter on; X-IF -> zone 2, cal mode 2, filter off. frequency is the carrier the CFO ppm is quoted against (the sub-6 beacon link).
_gain_note: Written explicitly on every opened channel: make() now resets RX DSA to 0 dB and TX VOP to 20 mA. TX 0 dB = maximum VOP, where the software lane measured linearity (W2). The ue_*_gain_* fields below are Iris units and inert on Houdini.
_beacon_note: nr_pss_bl: the band-limited beacon (AP-79): the 127-tone NR PSS at 240 kHz behind NR's 36-sample CP, then a guarded TRS pair on the central 96 tones (+-23 MHz); 1076 ticks. tx_full_scale 0.34 = -16 dBFS RMS at its 6.6 dB PAPR, the plan's DAC back-off. The argmax pick: the shipped first_path rule lands 2 samples early on this lobe (beacon_bandlimit_test).
_carried_note: tx_advance 247 is carried from the 122.88/NCO-500 bench and must be RE-MEASURED at mode V. The detection thresholds are DERIVED for nr_pss_bl on a simulated link (tests/comms-func/detection_calibration_test.cc): corr_scale 5 (coherence bar 0.2; noise-only max 0.080 of 400 windows, a beacon 30 dB under bench level 0.90), snr_floor_db 25 (legacy's 30 shifted by the measured -5.2 dB for this beacon at 0.34 peak on the filtered lane, 16.6 dB margin). ue_pilot_horizon counts FRAMES.
_comment: AP-79 ladder rung R2: R1 plus the X-band IF (UE TX ch1 -> BS RX ch2 at NCO 4380), same fft 256 numerology and 1 ms frame. Proves the per-channel NCO and zones with both bands at once. Next rung: houdini-dualband.json (R3, the 5G-like numerology).
_numerology_note: fft 256 at 122.88 = 480 kHz subcarriers; cp 64; 12 symbols x 320 + zero prefix 128 + postfix 128 = 4096 ticks, the old slot, 30 slots = 1 ms. 96 data subcarriers = 46.08 MHz (+-23.04, inside the +-24 MHz filter). The 128-tick prefix/postfix covers the TX prefilter margins (23/22).
_schedule_note: B, G, P, U then guards over 30 x 4096-tick slots = 1 ms, the old frame.
